title: Chapter 97 — The Document and Quote Engine
intro: Quotes at speed, communications, trade documents, and verification.

sections.title: Speed Without Errors
sections.content:
AI can generate quotes, proposals, emails, and trade documents in minutes. But speed without verification creates expensive mistakes.

Always verify AI-generated content before sending: prices, model numbers, availability, terms, and customer details. AI is fast. You are accurate. The combination is powerful.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating document generation, ask:

Is the salesperson using AI to generate documents faster — or still doing everything manually?
Are they verifying AI output before sending — or trusting it blindly?
Is document quality improving — or staying the same?
